description: This file defines the 'Hook' entity class in the 'org.apache.fineract.infrastructure.hooks.domain' package. It models the structure and behavior of hook objects used within the Fineract system, including fields for configuration, events, status, and relationships to templates. The class provides methods for creating instances from JSON commands, updating properties, and managing associated configuration and event sets.

classes.name: Hook
classes.description: Entity class representing a system hook with configuration, events, and template associations used for triggering actions within the Fineract platform.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Static factory method that creates a Hook instance from a JSON command, associating configurations and events, and setting active status.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates the hook's properties based on a JSON command, tracking changes and handling nested updates for events and configuration.

methods.name: getUgdTemplateId
methods.description: Retrieves the ID of the associated UGDS (Unified General Data) template if present.

methods.name: updateEvents
methods.description: Replaces the current set of hook events with a new set.

methods.name: updateConfig
methods.description: Replaces the current hook configuration set with a new set.
